about.title: Corning Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Corning sits along Interstate 5 in Tehama County, where the I-5 lanes and local streets like Marguerite Avenue carry most daily traffic. Public records for 2025 list no traffic deaths in the city, and that is worth stating plainly: a fatal crash here is uncommon, which is part of why one lands so hard in a community of 7,548 people. Wrongful death claims also arise away from the road, after a fall at a business, a medical error, or a workplace incident. In California, a wrongful death claim is a civil action, separate from any criminal case. The surviving spouse or domestic partner and children have first standing, followed by certain dependents or heirs. Most families have two years from the date of death to file, with a shorter window when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects you with an independent attorney who takes wrongful death cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits who may bring a wrongful death claim, starting with the spouse or domestic partner and children. An attorney can sort out standing for your family before anything is filed.

items.title: The two-year clock is real
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the deadline is shorter if a city, county, or state agency is involved. Getting connected early protects that window.

items.title: Losses beyond the funeral bill
items.desc: Recoverable losses can include funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. A civil claim addresses these regardless of what happens in any criminal case.

items.question: Corning recorded no traffic deaths in 2025. Will anyone take a case this rare seriously?
items.answer: Yes. The number of fatal crashes in a small city has no bearing on whether a particular death was caused by negligence. Attorneys in the LawProactive network evaluate each situation on its own facts, whether it happened on I-5, on Marguerite Avenue, or somewhere off the road entirely.

items.question: The person responsible is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and moves on its own track, separate from any criminal prosecution. Waiting for a criminal case to finish can eat into your two-year deadline, so it is worth speaking with an attorney sooner rather than later.

items.question: What if a government vehicle or a poorly maintained public road was involved?
items.answer: Claims against a government entity in California follow a much shorter timeline than the standard two years, often requiring a formal claim within months. Early morning crashes, which local records show clustering on Fridays between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m., sometimes involve public agencies or road conditions. An attorney can identify every responsible party and calendar the correct deadlines.
